envelope.description: Register the inline repo.stats handler in src/daemon/index.ts

body.title: Register the inline repo.stats handler in src/daemon/index.ts
body.summary: Add a 'repo.stats' handler to the daemon handler map (next to repo.list/daemon.status): read getGraphStore()+listRepos(db)+the queue, call collectRepoStats, and return the single RepoStats for params.repoPath (or `{ error: 'repo.stats: <path> is not a registered repo' }` when unregistered) or the full RepoStats[] when repoPath is omitted. Additive; no existing handler changes; read-only.
acceptanceChecks: 'repo.stats' is registered in the index.ts handler map and delegates to collectRepoStats/buildRepoStats; with repoPath it returns one RepoStats (or {error} when unregistered, not thrown); omitted returns RepoStats[] (=== [] when zero repos)
the handler mutates nothing (no writeFileSync/setConfigAtPath/store put/enqueue) and does not alter repo.list/daemon.status

tests.name: source-scan: src/daemon/index.ts registers a 'repo.stats' handler that delegates to collectRepoStats/buildRepoStats and returns a single RepoStats for params.repoPath else the RepoStats[] array

source-scan: the handler returns { error } (not throw) when repoPath is not in listRepos(), and is READ-ONLY (no writeFileSync/setConfigAtPath/store put/enqueue in the handler body); src/shared/types.ts declares the RepoStats interface
